clues.it: Carla era nella 10ª colonna, a nord di Rosa e nel Corridoio dei Geroglifici.
clues.en: Carla was in the 10th column, north of Rosa and in the Hall of Hieroglyphs.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a un sarcofago, a una colonna e in una stanza diversa da Tea.
clues.en: Sergio was beside a sarcophagus, a column and in a different room from Tea.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 6ª colonna, a nord di Fabio e nel Corridoio dei Geroglifici.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 6th column, north of Fabio and in the Hall of Hieroglyphs.

clues.it: Marta era nella 2ª colonna e nella 4ª riga, ma non era accanto a un sarcofago.
clues.en: Marta was in the 2nd column and in the 4th row, but was not beside a sarcophagus.

clues.it: Luca era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a una colonna e nella stessa stanza di Sergio.
clues.en: Luca was in the 4th column, beside a column and in the same room as Sergio.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Rosa era accanto a una pila di papiri e a nord di Elena.
clues.en: Rosa was beside a stack of papyri and north of Elena.

clues.it: Fabio era in una stanza diversa da Nino e nella Camera del Faraone.
clues.en: Fabio was in a different room from Nino and in the Pharaoh's Chamber.

clues.it: Olga era nella 9ª riga e a ovest di Ugo.
clues.en: Olga was in the 9th row and west of Ugo.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una colonna e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Nino was beside a column and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a un obelisco e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Elena was beside an obelisk and west of Marta.

clues.it: Anna era nella 12ª riga, l'unica seduta su una sedia e nella Camera del Faraone.
clues.en: Anna was in the 12th row, the only one sitting on a chair and in the Pharaoh's Chamber.

steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 3rd.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 1ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 1st, column 10th.
